title: Number of Single Divisor Triplets
summary: Given an array of positive integers, count the triplets of distinct indices where the sum of the elements at these indices is divisible by exactly one of the elements in the triplet.
statement: Given an array of positive integers, count the triplets of distinct indices where the sum of the elements at these indices is divisible by exactly one of the elements in the triplet.
constraints: Triplets use three distinct indices, and their order counts: each qualifying index set contributes six permutations.
Let total be the sum of the three selected values.
Exactly one of the three selected values, counting repeated occurrences, must divide total.
reference_solution:
def count_single_divisor_triplets(nums):
    from collections import Counter
    from itertools import combinations_with_replacement
    from math import comb
    counts=Counter(nums);answer=0
    for first,second,third in combinations_with_replacement(sorted(counts),3):
        values=(first,second,third);needed=Counter(values)
        if any(counts[value]<amount for value,amount in needed.items()):continue
        total=sum(values)
        if sum(total%value==0 for value in values)!=1:continue
        ways=1
        for value,amount in needed.items():ways*=comb(counts[value],amount)
        answer+=6*ways
    return answer
